fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Fires a spray of silver shot in a cone ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting School
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 12 damage and knocks the target back 2.5 tiles, then darts on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Slip the Grip
fusions.desc: You slip 2 tiles from where you stood, and for 3 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Off the Line
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
